## Learning objectives

- Recap on what the assumptions of simple linear regression are
- Learn how to assess and diagnose simple linear regression models
- Understand what to do when model assumptions are violated
- Learn how transformations can be applied to data

## Readings

### Suggested readings

- {{< fa link >}} [A guide to testing the assumptions of linear regression](https://godatadrive.com/blog/basic-guide-to-test-assumptions-of-linear-regression-in-r)
- {{< fa file-pdf >}} [Understanding and checking the assumptions of linear regression](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/ceo.12358)
- {{< fa podcast >}} [The Dark Art of Regression Diagnostics ](https://quantitude.org/s4e19-regression-diagnostics/)
